name: One Draenei's Junk...
label: Quest
description: One Draenei's Junk...: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well, after that display of voracious greed, I feel nauseous.
Regardless, I shall not dwell too long on your material addiction.
For each imperfect draenethyst fragment you turn in, I shall reward you with more junk. My junk heap gets smaller while your junk heap gets larger. On Draenor we call this a 'win-win' situation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You truly disgust me, traveler. A grown friend drooling over a pile of junk? Pitiful! Take your reward and get out of my sight.
Sounds familiar? It should, because I say it a thousand times per day.
Oh how I loathe this world.
